name: Stash v0.9.116 — Tidal fix
body:
Tidal fix.

- Stash now asks Tidal far less often, which keeps Tidal working more reliably for everyone.

---

## Install

Download `Stash.apk` below and open it on your Android device. If you've got a previous Stash release installed, this upgrades in place — your library, sync history, and settings are preserved.

**Requires:** Android 8.0 (API 26) or newer.

See the [README](https://github.com/rawnaldclark/Stash#installation) for first-time setup.


## What's Changed
* fix(tidal): cut app-to-relay request volume (cache, busy backoff, dedupe, sweep cap) by @rawnaldclark in https://github.com/rawnaldclark/Stash/pull/604


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/rawnaldclark/Stash/compare/v0.9.115...v0.9.116
